This is your secure space to store private thoughts, credentials, and encrypted notes.

🔒 **Local-first Encryption**: Everything you write can be encrypted using military-grade **AES-256 GCM** encryption with a Master Password.

☁️ **Google Drive Backup**: Connect your account via Cloud Sync to securely and privately back up your notes, protected by your custom password.

⚡ **Customizable views and tag filtering**: Filter notes by tags like Work, Personal, and Private, and arrange them with custom ordering!

Happy note taking!

**Goal: Hypertrophy, power, and cardiovascular capacity.**

**Weekly Schedule: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri**

### Block 1: Agility & Power Focus
- **Russian Push-ups**: 3 sets of 3 to 5 reps.
- **Clap Push-ups**: 3 sets of 4 to 6 reps.
- **Pull-ups (Bar)**: 3 sets of 5 to 6 reps (explosive).
- **Pike Push-ups**: 3 sets of 5 reps.

### Block 2: Push Endurance
- **Arc Push-ups**: 10 reps (5 per arm).
- **Australian Pull-ups**: 3 sets of 10 to 12 reps.
- **Fist Push-ups**: 20 reps.
- **Regular Push-ups**: 3 sets of 10 reps.
- **Front Delt Raises**: 15 reps.

### Block 3: Lower Body
- **Squats**: 30 reps.
- **Explosive Squats**: 3 sets of 15 reps.
- **Bulgarian Lunges**: 3 sets of 10 reps per leg.
- **Forward Lunges**: 40 reps (20 per leg).
- **Glute Bridge**: 30 reps.
- **Leg In and Out**: 30 reps.

### Block 4: Core & Cardio
- **Leg Raises**: 25 reps.
- **Mountain Climbers**: 100 reps.
- **Planks**: 3 sets of 1 minute.

### Block 5: Stretching
- **Cat-Cow**: 10 cycles.
- **Child's Pose**: 20-30 seconds.
- **Wall Chest Stretch**: 20-30 seconds.
- **Triceps Stretch**: 20-30 seconds.
- **Downward-Facing Dog**: 20-30 seconds.
- **Hip Flexor Stretch**: 20-30 seconds.
- **Wrist Stretch**: 20-30 seconds.

Consistency is key! Try to maintain this order for at least 4 weeks before increasing reps.

Secure Notes is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. Google OAuth authentication is handled by Google and governed by its own Terms of Service. By using this application, you agree that:

1. You are solely responsible for your master password confidentiality.
2. Notes are stored locally on your device.
3. Cloud backups are optional and encrypted before upload.
4. The developer is not liable for any data loss.
5. This application is provided free of charge and may be modified without prior notice.

AI assistance runs entirely on your device or local network, depending on the selected backend:

• **Ollama (Local HTTP)**: Connects to a local LLM server (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio) on your network. No data leaves your LAN.
• **On-Device**: Runs a model directly on this device (model download required). No network connection needed.

• AI features are OPTIONAL and disabled by default.
• You can enable or disable AI at any time in settings.
• No data is ever sent to external servers, cloud APIs, or third parties.
• Your notes and prompts remain private and under your control.

All encryption and decryption happens EXCLUSIVELY on your device:

🔐 **AES-256-GCM Encryption** — Military-grade with built-in authentication.
🔑 **PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256** — 200,000 iterations, 256-bit key.
🧂 **Random Salt & IV** — Generated per-note via SecureRandom.
🔒 **Local Master Password** — Never transmitted, never stored in plaintext, only in memory during session.

Without the master password, it is MATHEMATICALLY IMPOSSIBLE to decrypt your notes. Neither the developer, Google, nor any third party can access them.

Cloud backups via Google Drive are OPTIONAL:

☁️ **Private Storage** — Data stored in AppData folder (user-inaccessible).
🔐 **Encrypted Before Upload** — Backups encrypted with your master password.
🔑 **OAuth 2.0 Authentication** — via Credential Manager and Play Services.
🔌 **Disconnect Anytime** — Revoke access from settings.

No data is shared without your explicit consent.
Google OAuth handles authentication only. Google Drive API is used solely for backup storage.
